intro.answerFirst: New Orleans' brunch scene ranges from casual to fine dining, costing approximately $12-$75 per person, with Commander's Palace and Atchafalaya being the most recommended spots by locals. This Reddit-backed guide highlights the city's best brunch experiences, avoiding tourist traps and focusing on local favorites for an authentic taste of NOLA.
body: New Orleans is the birthplace of brunch, and the city takes the meal seriously. From Commander's Palace's legendary jazz brunch to Elizabeth's praline bacon in the Bywater, NOLA offers brunch experiences you won't find anywhere else. Budget about $12–$75 per person depending on whether you're going casual or fine dining.

We analyzed hundreds of Reddit posts across r/AskNOLA, r/NewOrleans, and r/NOLA to find the 12 brunch spots that actual New Orleanians recommend — not just the tourist-trap chains that show up on every generic list. Each spot was mentioned in at least 3 separate threads by different users.

The range spans Creole fine dining institutions (Commander's Palace, Brennan's), neighborhood favorites (Atchafalaya, Elizabeth's, Bearcat), and everything in between. Most serve brunch on weekends; several are open daily. Reservations are essential at the upscale spots.

picks.name: Commander's Palace
picks.whyItMadeTheList: The crown jewel of NOLA brunch. 130+ years of Creole excellence with live jazz. Reddit unanimously calls it unmissable.
picks.whatToOrder: Commander's Palace, a Creole fine dining institution, is known for its Jazz Brunch, though pricing details are unavailable. For the best experience, order the prix-fixe brunch package, including the Cochon de Lait Eggs Benedict, Turtle Soup, and Creole Bread Pudding Soufflé.
picks.insiderTip: The crown jewel of NOLA brunch. 130+ years of Creole excellence with live jazz. Reddit unanimously calls it unmissable.

picks.name: Brennan's
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Where Bananas Foster was born. Brennan's 80-year-old French Quarter breakfast is refined without being stuffy. Reddit regulars say it edges out Commander's for food quality.
picks.whatToOrder: Brennan's, a Creole fine dining establishment, is famous for inventing Bananas Foster in 1951, though pricing details are unavailable. The three-course brunch is legendary, and you should order the Bananas Foster, Eggs Hussarde, and Turtle Soup.
picks.insiderTip: Where Bananas Foster was born. Brennan's 80-year-old French Quarter breakfast is refined without being stuffy. Reddit regulars say it edges out Commander's for food quality.

picks.name: Atchafalaya
picks.whyItMadeTheList: The locals' favorite. Highest-rated on this list at 4.7★. The build-your-own Bloody Mary bar is iconic, and the Creole-Louisiana brunch menu hits every note.
picks.whatToOrder: Atchafalaya, a Louisiana brunch spot, is a local favorite with a build-your-own Bloody Mary bar, though pricing details are unavailable. The Bloody Mary bar alone is worth the trip, but also order the Shrimp & Grits and Cochon de Lait Benedict.
picks.insiderTip: The locals' favorite. Highest-rated on this list at 4.7★. The build-your-own Bloody Mary bar is iconic, and the Creole-Louisiana brunch menu hits every note.

picks.name: Surrey's Café & Juice Bar
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Colorful Magazine Street café that nails the casual-but-excellent brunch. Fresh juices, Latin-influenced dishes, and zero pretension.
picks.whatToOrder: Surrey's Café & Juice Bar, a brunch café, is known for its made-from-scratch menu, though pricing details are unavailable. Order the Bananas Foster French Toast, Shrimp & Grits, and fresh-squeezed juices.
picks.insiderTip: Colorful Magazine Street café that nails the casual-but-excellent brunch. Fresh juices, Latin-influenced dishes, and zero pretension.

picks.name: Elizabeth's
picks.whyItMadeTheList: The Bywater institution that Reddit keeps recommending. Down-home Southern cooking with local art on the walls and praline bacon that should be illegal.
picks.whatToOrder: Elizabeth's, a Southern brunch destination, is famous for its life-changing Praline Bacon, though pricing details are unavailable. Be sure to order the Praline Bacon, Bananas Foster French Toast, and Boudin Balls.
picks.insiderTip: The Bywater institution that Reddit keeps recommending. Down-home Southern cooking with local art on the walls and praline bacon that should be illegal.

picks.name: Bearcat Cafe
picks.whyItMadeTheList: The Uptown brunch darling that Reddit consistently names as a top pick. Eclectic comfort food, great cocktails, and a breezy patio.
picks.whatToOrder: Bearcat Cafe, an eclectic brunch spot, offers artisanal coffee and a surprisingly excellent cocktail menu, though pricing details are unavailable. Try the Sweet Potato Pancakes, Fried Chicken Benedict, and explore the cocktail menu.
picks.insiderTip: The Uptown brunch darling that Reddit consistently names as a top pick. Eclectic comfort food, great cocktails, and a breezy patio.

picks.name: Willa Jean
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Retro-chic bakery-café that's a brunch powerhouse. The baked goods alone are worth a visit. That warm cookie skillet is a religious experience.
picks.whatToOrder: Willa Jean, a Southern bakery-café, is a must-visit for its Warm Chocolate Chip Cookie Skillet, though pricing details are unavailable. Don't leave without trying the cookie, and also order the Buttermilk Biscuits and BBQ Shrimp & Grits.
picks.insiderTip: Retro-chic bakery-café that's a brunch powerhouse. The baked goods alone are worth a visit. That warm cookie skillet is a religious experience.

picks.name: Paladar 511
picks.whyItMadeTheList: The Marigny sleeper hit that Reddit calls 'the best brunch in the city.' Mediterranean-meets-New Orleans with seasonal wood-fired dishes.
picks.whatToOrder: Paladar 511, a Mediterranean brunch spot, offers a seasonally changing brunch menu featuring fresh ingredients, though pricing details are unavailable. Order the wood-fired pizzas, seasonal pasta, and shakshuka, trusting whatever's fresh.
picks.insiderTip: The Marigny sleeper hit that Reddit calls 'the best brunch in the city.' Mediterranean-meets-New Orleans with seasonal wood-fired dishes.

picks.name: Café Amelie
picks.whyItMadeTheList: A romantic French Quarter courtyard with a fountain and wisteria — Café Amelie is where you take someone you want to impress.
picks.whatToOrder: Café Amelie, a courtyard brunch destination, elevates the dining experience with its atmosphere, though pricing details are unavailable. Order the Cochon de Lait Po'Boy, Roasted Beet Salad, and Bread Pudding.
picks.insiderTip: A romantic French Quarter courtyard with a fountain and wisteria — Café Amelie is where you take someone you want to impress.

picks.name: The Elysian Bar
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Brunch in a converted church at the Hotel Peter and Paul. Sophisticated Mediterranean-Creole brunch in one of the most beautiful rooms in New Orleans.
picks.whatToOrder: The Elysian Bar, a hotel bar brunch spot, is known for its outstanding House Spritz cocktail, though pricing details are unavailable. Order the Baked Eggs in Purgatory, French Rolled Omelette, and brunch cocktails.
picks.insiderTip: Brunch in a converted church at the Hotel Peter and Paul. Sophisticated Mediterranean-Creole brunch in one of the most beautiful rooms in New Orleans.

picks.name: Mr. B's Bistro
picks.whyItMadeTheList: The Brennan family's more relaxed French Quarter bistro. Mr. B's BBQ Shrimp is one of the most famous dishes in New Orleans — buttery, peppery, and messy in the best way.
picks.whatToOrder: Mr. B's Bistro, a Creole bistro, is renowned for its signature BBQ Shrimp, though pricing details are unavailable. Order the BBQ Shrimp, Gumbo Ya Ya, and Bread Pudding with Irish Whiskey Sauce.
picks.insiderTip: The Brennan family's more relaxed French Quarter bistro. Mr. B's BBQ Shrimp is one of the most famous dishes in New Orleans — buttery, peppery, and messy in the best way.

picks.name: Ruby Slipper Café
picks.whyItMadeTheList: The brunch chain that locals debate but tourists keep coming back to. Multiple locations, consistent quality, affordable, and open early — perfect for your first morning in NOLA.
picks.whatToOrder: Ruby Slipper Café, a classic brunch spot, is known for its Eggs Cochon (debris topped with poached eggs and hollandaise), though pricing details are unavailable. Also order the BBQ Shrimp & Grits and Pain Perdu.
picks.insiderTip: The brunch chain that locals debate but tourists keep coming back to. Multiple locations, consistent quality, affordable, and open early — perfect for your first morning in NOLA.

faq.question: What is the best brunch spot in New Orleans?
faq.answer: Commander's Palace and Atchafalaya are the two most recommended brunch spots among locals and on Reddit. Commander's Palace offers refined Creole dining with live jazz, while Atchafalaya is the more relaxed local favorite with a famous build-your-own Bloody Mary bar.

faq.question: Where do New Orleans locals go for brunch?
faq.answer: Locals favor Atchafalaya in the Irish Channel, Paladar 511 in the Marigny, Elizabeth's in the Bywater, and Bearcat Cafe Uptown. These spots rarely appear on tourist lists but consistently dominate Reddit recommendations.

faq.question: Is Brennan's worth it for brunch?
faq.answer: Yes. Brennan's is where Bananas Foster was invented in 1951, and the three-course breakfast remains one of the most iconic meals in New Orleans.

faq.question: What is a jazz brunch in New Orleans?
faq.answer: A jazz brunch features live jazz music during the meal. Commander's Palace hosts the most famous weekend jazz brunch, and Mr. B's Bistro offers a popular Sunday jazz brunch. Expect slightly higher prices but an unforgettable atmosphere.

faq.question: How much does brunch cost in New Orleans?
faq.answer: Casual spots like Bearcat Cafe and Ruby Slipper run $12-20 per person. Mid-range options like Atchafalaya and Surrey's are $18-30. Fine dining brunches at Commander's Palace and Brennan's range from $45-75 per person with cocktails.

faq.question: Do I need reservations for brunch in New Orleans?
faq.answer: Highly recommended for Commander's Palace, Brennan's, and Paladar 511. Casual spots like Bearcat and Elizabeth's are walk-in only — expect a 30-60 minute wait on weekends.

faq.question: What should I order at a New Orleans brunch?
faq.answer: Don't miss: Eggs Benedict variations (especially Cochon de Lait or BBQ Shrimp), Shrimp and Grits, Bananas Foster French Toast, and a Bloody Mary. Praline Bacon at Elizabeth's and the Cookie Skillet at Willa Jean are must-tries.
